lastCompletedStory.title: Remove the orphaned commitOnMain helper and its tests

nextStoryContext: All three non-operator stories in this PRD now pass. The on-main writer layer is fully ref-only: commitOnMain has been removed from src/git/on-main.ts and its dead tests deleted from test/on-main-multi.test.ts. The writeFile? optional param threading in issue-specify/journal/triage writer options is intentionally left in place for backward compat (no callers remain post-cutover, but removing it would be a breaking public API change -- defer to a follow-up). PRD is ready for /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal dead-code removal: no external npm library touched. Removed commitOnMain export from src/git/on-main.ts and its tests from test/on-main-multi.test.ts.
